purpose: Defines the locked source-of-truth foundation artifacts for synthetic AA data generation. Future stages must use only these locked artifacts and ignore earlier drafts.
global_rules_for_future_stages: Do not use earlier drafts or superseded versions.
Do not reinterpret locked persona, account, starting-state, catalog, year-arc, or month-plan decisions.
Do not add new rare events unless a later explicit reviewer-approved patch modifies the locked plan.
Do not generate raw AA payload until the raw AA generation stage.
Day Plan may create daily scaffolding and day-level contexts, but not final AA transaction payloads.
Transactions must later respect account visibility, payment rails, card-posting-first behavior, pay-later behavior, self-transfer pairing, and reimbursement lag rules.
Self-transfers are not income or spending.
Friend and family reimbursements are not salary or ordinary income.
Card purchases post to card accounts first; bank impact occurs only when card bills are paid.
Priya cannot use BNPL or revolve credit card.
Aarav can use Simpl only near salary-end and can revolve card only in locked revolve months.
Spend envelopes are non-additive planning bands, not targets.

next_stage.name: Day Plan v1
next_stage.reason: Generate one month first to test daily realism before scaling to all months and both personas.
